title: Paint & Wet Media
welcome_lead: Watercolour, acrylic and oil — the painting trio.
meta_desc: KS3 paint materials: watercolour, acrylic, oil and brushes.
final_note: Each paint has its own drying time and texture.

walkthroughs.body_html: Watercolour works light-to-dark. The white of the paper is your highlight. Lay a thin wash first, let it dry, then add darker layers.
Acrylic dries in minutes. You can paint dark to light, layer thickly, and it cleans with water. Great for posters and bold mark-making.
Oil paint dries over days, allowing blending and subtle effects. Impasto means applying paint so thick it stands off the canvas — Van Gogh's trick.
